blocks.markdown:
## What the title card takes from the post

The title, the lede and the photograph are this hero's own fields; the mark over the title is the site's, as on the front page. The photograph is the card's ground, so it is published without alt text or a lightbox. There is no accent word: every letter is its own box, and a gradient clipped to a word does not reach into them, so the word would vanish.
